facts.title: Blueberry Cobbler with Almond Topping
ingredients: 2 pounds blueberries (about 6 cups or 3 pints), fresh or frozen*
¼ cup maple syrup or honey
2 ½ cups (225 grams) blanched almond flour**
Optional: 1 teaspoon turbinado sugar (raw sugar) for sprinkling on top
Vanilla ice cream or whipped cream, for serving
facts.author: Kathryne Taylor
